segments.text: Vidya Samhaira tadotthu Subnadarshanam, although he is established in samadhi, although he is established in God consciousness in samadhi.
After a few minutes, tadotthu Subnadarshanam, he enters, he gets entry in dreaming state.
It does not get entry in reckfulness, and in samadhi you cannot maintain awareness.
For instance, take this point that you have entered in samadhi, completely you have entered into samadhi.
Then in samadhi your awareness is not maintained wholeheartedly with great effort.
Then what happens? After a while you enter in dreaming state.
This happens to all yogis. This is the great crisis in the field of yogic world.
What is the great crisis? Not only crisis, it is torture.
Everybody misses that. All yogis. I don't talk of worldly people.
I talk of yogis. Yogis generally miss this state.
Then they go to sleep in dreaming state.
Yes, because that is so subtle. The state of samadhi is so subtle. This is subtlest.
Because gross is wake-up-beakfulness, subtle is dreaming state, subtlest is soundlessly.
Sattlest then the subtlest is samadhi. So it is a great job to maintain awareness there.
You can't maintain awareness easily there. There is only one way how you can maintain awareness.
Your master must be very happy to you. You can maintain awareness there.
Otherwise it is impossible. What happens? You don't come in wakefulness.
You just enter in dreaming state. Because you can't maintain awareness.
When you can't maintain awareness, it prefers dreaming state instead of wakefulness.
Because in wakefulness you are aware. In dreaming state you are not so aware.
For instance, your father is dead. If somebody says that your father is here,
will you believe in wakefulness? You won't believe. In dreaming state you will believe.
How you believe there? It is because your awareness is not full.
Your awareness is very low there.
What do they say? It is subtle state. If awareness is less there then why?
They call it subtle state. Then in jagat. Jagat would be subtlest. There is more awareness in jagat.
But that is awareness of differentiatedness. In wakefulness, in dreaming state and in dreamless state,
these are all awarenesses of differentiated perceptions. There is nowhere undifferentiated perception.
So this is the way of these three. Because whenever you first enter in samadhi,
you enter in samadhi through dreaming state. You never enter in samadhi in wakefulness.
At first, if you meditate more and more and more and grow your awareness in meditation,
at first you get entry in samadhi through the state of dreaming state.
In dreaming state you enter in samadhi first, not in wakefulness.
Because dreaming state is subtle and your awareness can be maintained there at first.
When it is established fully, then you can get entry in wakefulness also.
When it is established in its fullness. Otherwise for those who are very low in meditation,
who have not so much capacity and ability of meditating.
The meditation power, who have very little, they get entry in samadhi in samadhi in sound sleep,
not in dreaming state also. They get entry in samadhi in sound sleep, not in dreaming state.
And by and by, they meditate, go on meditating and they get entry in dreaming state.
And when that awareness is strengthened, developed, then you get entry in samadhi through wakefulness.
Once you get entry in samadhi through wakefulness, that samadhi becomes most firm.
It is why that when with ya, that supreme knowledge of God consciousness is lessened,
gets is weakened by the lack of awareness, you get entry in dreaming state.
You fall in dreaming state, in the sphere of in the world of dreaming state.
That is to tadutu sopne darshan.

When this supreme pure knowledge of God consciousness is destroyed by the lack of awareness,
which is the expansion of knowledge of one's own self.
Destruction does not means real destruction. Destruction means when it is subsided,
when this gets subsided.
Then tadutasya, kramath krama, nyakrata, vidyaya, samskara, siya, sopne siya.
Then, from that, he gets rise in dreaming state.
Vedamaya siya, vikalfa, prapanjuru, pasyadarshanam, suktam, onma, janam bhavati.
And he is thrown in the sphere, in the world of differentiated perceptions.
In dreaming state.
No hope of God consciousness there.

The yogi who does not maintain awareness,
at the time when he achieves the supreme yogic powers,
when he achieves, when he attends experiences,
the supreme yogic powers at that achievement,
at the point of that achievement, the yogi who gets his awareness detached,
detached from further achievement.
For instance, you get power of flying in air.
At that time, if you make your mind detached from God consciousness,
detached from awareness of God consciousness, your awareness is lessened.
Because you are overjoyed, you are so happy that you have gained so much.
And you have gained so much, you have lessened that power of going forward, forward on the path.
The one who has lessened that power by the attainment of these yogic powers,
to him tam anitte shubo ge shu yoji antivinaya ka.
To him, all obstacles of life become players.
For him, all obstacles of life become players. Can you understand?
They play. They play him. He becomes played.
It has not become player. They play with him.
In spanda, it is narrated in this shloka,
anyata atu satantra syaat, srishti ista dharma kattata,
satatam lauki ka seva jagra subna padaddei.
Anyata means, when he lacks awareness,
when he does not maintain full awareness of God consciousness,
then the creative energy of Lord Shiva becomes independent.
Otherwise, it was dependable to him.
The creative energy of Lord Shiva was dependent to him.
Then he does not maintain awareness,
then creative energy of Lord Shiva becomes independent to him.
So, she plays with him.
Satatam lauki, just like ordinary people.
These yogis become just like ordinary people,
jagrat subna padaddei, in wakefulness or in dreaming state.
In wakefulness, they do what others do.
And in dreaming state, they experience what others experience,
others worldly people experience.
So, there is no difference between yogi and common person
because awareness is not there.
Awareness is not maintained there.
So, atastya, nittam shuddh vijayavimarshe parinayava yoginabhaviyam.
So, whatever happens, yogi must maintain awareness in continuity.
